claim: TrendForce estimated TSMC's 1Q20 foundry revenue at US$10.2 billion, a 54.1% share of the global foundry market; the top 10 foundries together had US$18.06 billion and 95.7% of the market, so TSMC held about 56.5% of top-10 revenue. CSET (2021) cites this as TSMC's 54% logic foundry market share.
evidence: TrendForce table 'Ranking of the Global Top 10 Foundries by Revenue, 1Q20 (Unit: Million USD)': "TSMC | 10,200 | 7,096 | 43.7% | 54.1%"; "Top 10 Total | 18,060 | 13,737 | 31.5% | 95.7%". CSET p. 22: "Market leader TSMC has 54 percent of the world's logic foundry market share" (fn 76)

metric.name: TSMC foundry market share
metric.population: TrendForce total foundry market (implied about US$18.9bn; top 10 = 95.7%); Samsung includes System LSI
metric.methodology: TrendForce estimate compiled from company data

notes: Corrects CLM-2351, which described 54.1% as a share of top-10 revenue. 10,200/18,060 = 56.5%. Table read from the image on the TrendForce page. Newer: TrendForce 2Q26 72.5% (CLM-2355).
